cells.B: A starter catalog covering iPhone 12–18 families (iPhone 12–16 as JV, Non-PTA and PTA kit prices), Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 4–8 Ultra, Google Pixel 6–11 families and current retailer-listed Samsung, OPPO, realme, vivo, Infinix, Tecno, Xiaomi, Honor, itel, Nothing and Motorola models.

This cannot guarantee every model and SKU sold in every Pakistani shop. Stock changes daily. Older iPhones/Pixel models may be discontinued, used, repacked or imported; the spreadsheet flags these limitations.

Market Reference Price is an online listing or market-guide reference, not a binding supplier quote. iPhone 12–16 prices are KIT prices (phone only, graded used/open-box): the Non-PTA price of each model is a live retailer anchor and the JV and PTA prices are derived from it using the factors on the Price Model sheet. iPhone 17/18 and Pixel Non-PTA rows were not re-researched in this pass. Confirm prices with at least two suppliers before publication.
RaesTech Buy Now Price is calculated at 10% below the Market Reference Price.
Installment total stays at the full reference price: 0% discount and 0% additional markup. Monthly figure is illustrative total ÷ 12; use the actual configured first-payment schedule if different.

Imported Pixels do not automatically have official Google Pakistan warranty. 'PTA Registered' means the device IMEI must be verified. CPID/Modified is not equivalent to official PTA registration and must never be advertised as Official PTA.

JV = carrier-locked import that needs an interposer chip or SIM-time. Non-PTA (FU) = factory-unlocked but not registered for local networks. PTA = registered for Pakistani networks. JV is not PTA approval and not factory unlock. iPhone 12–16 rows are priced in all three statuses.

Specs/colors are model-level summaries. Any field marked 'verify', 'reported' or 'pending' needs confirmation against the exact manufacturer regional SKU before publishing. Color options do not guarantee every color/storage combination is in stock.
A retailer page is not proof of factory-sealed stock. Confirm seal, activation/warranty status, exact IMEI, PTA status, storage, color and seller invoice before advertising box pack.
RaesTech policy: NO CASH ON DELIVERY. Verify cleared funds before dispatch.
Filter out low-confidence estimates or records with unresolved specs before importing into a live store. Keep source and confidence columns for admin review.
